entities.summary: Georgy Petrovich Razumovsky born 19 January 1936) is a Soviet politician who was a high-ranking official in the Communist Party of the Soviet Union (CPSU). He was a protégé of Mikhail Gorbachev, serving as Chairman of the Party Building and Cadre Work Commission and Head of the Party Building and Cadre Work.
